Did you come from a broken home, are you a rebel against an unjust system, or are you earning the fee to buy your sister out of slavery?''"<br />"''Actually, I was a graduate student in Xenoarchaeology at the University of Ketaris. '''Naj Pandoor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] freelance [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. As a teenager Pandoor was a student of [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeology]] at the [[University of Ketaris]]. Soon after the school went bankrupt, he decided to be a smuggler. Pandoor went with [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Frayne]] and [[Jyl Somtay]] on an expedition to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].
